text:
cheng: Quick check — onboarding zeta8b weights. CI failed with checksum mismatch when trying to mirror from HF path. I think presign token expired. Where are canonical S3 paths and who can grant read for ingest role?

maria: Which HF repo/url? paste the manifest line pls.

cheng: hf://bigmodels/zeta8b/v1/... (manifest sha256: abcdef1234). CI log snippet: `ERROR: checksum mismatch: expected abcdef1234 got abcdffff`. Also tokenizer test failing: token offsets off by 1 in whitespace runs.

alex: I can grant read to arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/artifact-ingest if you add the path to registry: `s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta8b/v1/` and set ACL to bucket-owner-full-control.

ops-oncall: pinging infra for presign TTL and mirror job.

infra-bot: Mirror job enqueued -> job id 3829. Presign TTL default 1h, can bump to 24h for handoff. Use `rwd-cli artifacts presign --path s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta8b/v1 --ttl 86400`.

maria: Tokenizer quirk — zeta8b uses sentencepiece with legacy unk-id shift. We need to run our tokenizer-normalize step: `python tools/tokenizer_fix.py --model zeta8b --fix-offsets` before packaging.

cheng: thanks. Who owns adding manifest entry? I can submit a PR but need a reviewer.

alex: I can review today. Make sure to include `metadata.checksum.sha256`, `origin: hf://bigmodels/zeta8b/v1`, and `mirror: s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta8b/v1` in manifest.

cheng: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/artifact-registry/pull/548 — added manifest + script hook. CI still failing on checksum in mirror stage.

ci-bot: build #548.3 failed: mirror checksum mismatch. Logs -> https://ci.redwood.com/build/548.3/log

maria: Quick test: pull the file directly from HF and compute sha256 locally: `curl -L $HF_URL -o weights.pt && sha256sum weights.pt` — does it match abcdef1234?

cheng: ran locally — sha256 matches HF. Mirror step must be altering bytes (maybe compression). Mirror job uses `--gzip` by default for transfer, which changes checksum. Need to set `--preserve-raw`.

infra-bot: Mirror job default changed last month to gzip on upload. Submitted change to allow `--preserve-raw` flag per-request. For now, use manual sync: `aws s3 cp --no-guess-mime-type --content-encoding '' weights.pt s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta8b/v1/weights.pt`.

alex: After upload with preserve-raw, update manifest checksum and re-run CI. ping me when done.

cheng: uploaded raw, updated manifest, re-triggering CI.

ci-bot: build #548.4 passed. :tada:

maria: follow-up: add a tokenizer smokecheck to the preflight that runs `python tools/tokenizer_fix.py --check` and fails the PR if offsets differ.

alex: Agreed — filing a tiny GH action job.

ops-oncall: Note for ops: if customers request dedicated mirrors, we'll need to automate ACL grants and presign TTL change flow.

cheng: thanks everyone. leaving checklist: (1) manifest PR merged, (2) ingest role added, (3) mirror raw done, (4) tokenizer smokecheck in CI. Marking done after PR merged.

alex: :thumbsup:

maria: :eyes:
